title: LocalSend — Discovery
script: Sending a file between different devices should not need a cloud upload. LocalSend transfers over your local network. Both devices need to discover each other there. The official project supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux. It does not require an account. Pick a device, accept the request, and check the received file. That is useful at home. It also means network discovery and device permissions matter. Next I am testing photos, a large video, and a folder against a cloud workflow.
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: Phone-to-desktop and desktop-to-phone without a cloud upload.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: Sending a file between different devices should not need a cloud upload.
Different devices. One local file transfer.
No account, no cloud upload. What is the catch?
strongestHook: Sending a file between different devices should not need a cloud upload.
directorBrief: Direct this as a useful discovery with one important limit: Phone-to-desktop and desktop-to-phone without a cloud upload. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Use two available supported devices on the same controlled local network. Record device OS, app versions, discovery permissions and transfer mode. Send one non-sensitive sample both directions, accept on receiver and open it. Capture official platform list separately from tested-device scope. Do not expose device names, private Wi-Fi identifiers or personal file contents.
evidenceRequirements: Verify platform support, local-network requirements and account behavior.
